summary: Owned served-runtime verification reached a real capability boundary. A representative local Chromium binary exists (/usr/bin/chromium), but this execution environment cannot resolve juanmanuelpm.github.io, so Chromium cannot perform the required network navigation to GitHub Pages. Direct public-page retrieval through the web surface is also unavailable. Current repository bytes were independently reopened and source-level invariants remain truthful, but no served/browser PASS, authenticated transport PASS, or fresh-worker wake PASS is claimed.
